hunks.baseline: At some point, my body had become sturdy enough to stay perfectly fine even after going three days and nights without rest. Even so, being able to get a full night’s sleep was a wonderful thing.
hunks.sol: At some point, I’d become the kind of person who could go three days and nights without sleep and still be fine. Even so, getting a good night’s rest was a wonderful thing.

hunks.baseline: Especially when I woke up refreshed in a place where I was staying with my precious family.
hunks.sol: Especially when I woke up refreshed in the place where my family was staying.

hunks.baseline: Sounding refreshed, I took my seat, and Team Leader Choi looked at me sourly from across the enormous dining table.
hunks.sol: I sat down at the enormous dining table, and Team Leader Choi gave me a sour look from across it.

hunks.baseline: “This is my home, technically.”
hunks.sol: “This is my home.”

hunks.baseline: “Is that what matters right now?”
hunks.sol: “Is that important right now?”

hunks.baseline: “It is not a trivial matter. We are discussing legal ownership.”
hunks.sol: “I would say so. It is a matter of legal ownership.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m starting to wonder if homeless people can even bear to live.”
hunks.sol: “How’s a man without a house supposed to live with this kind of treatment?”

hunks.baseline: “Anyone listening to you would think you truly had neither a home nor money.”
hunks.sol: “Anyone listening would think you really had no house and no money.”

hunks.baseline: I had a house under my own name now, and more money than I knew what to do with.
hunks.sol: I had a house in my own name now, and more money than I knew what to do with.

hunks.baseline: But even if trillions of won were sleeping in my bank account, finding a safer place for my family and me to stay would be nearly impossible.
hunks.sol: But even with trillions of won sitting in my bank account, I’d be hard-pressed to find a safer place for my family and me to stay.

hunks.baseline: From the outside, it looked like nothing more than an enormous mansion. In reality, it was an impregnable fortress wrapped in layer upon layer of protective Magic.
hunks.sol: From the outside, it looked like an enormous mansion. In reality, it was an impregnable fortress wrapped in layer upon layer of protective Magic.

hunks.baseline: And since the public still knew it as Cheon Taemin’s mansion, it would not be an exaggeration to say that it carried more symbolic weight than even the Blue House.
hunks.sol: The public still knew it as Cheon Taemin’s mansion, too. Its symbolic weight might even surpass the Blue House’s.

hunks.baseline: *With everyone watching, breaking in is practically impossible. Even if an S-rank Hunter attacked, we could buy more than enough time.*
hunks.sol: *With so many eyes on this place, breaking in is next to impossible. Even if an S-rank Hunter attacked, the defenses would buy us plenty of time.*

hunks.baseline: For someone like me, who put my family’s safety above all else in every situation, it was the perfect place.
hunks.sol: For someone who put his family’s safety first no matter what, it was the perfect place.

hunks.baseline: Of course, Team Leader Choi’s perspective might have been a little different, considering he had suddenly ended up living with us.
hunks.sol: Of course, Team Leader Choi might feel differently about suddenly having us as housemates.

hunks.baseline: “Now that I think about it, I am taking advantage of you a bit. Should I start paying rent this month?”
hunks.sol: “Now that I think about it, I’m being pretty shameless. Should I start paying rent this month?”

hunks.baseline: “I will accept it if you offer. At ten million won per person, forty million won a month should be about right.”
hunks.sol: “If you offer, I will accept it. At ten million won per person, forty million a month should do.”

hunks.baseline: I gazed out the window at the sunlight pouring down and muttered:
hunks.sol: I looked out the window at the sunlight pouring down.

hunks.baseline: “Ah, the weather’s nice.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, nice weather.”

hunks.baseline: “By the way, why is it so expensive? You even got the calculation wrong.”
hunks.sol: “Anyway, why’s the rent so high? You even got the math wrong.”

hunks.baseline: “What are you talking about? Ten million per person means thirty million, not forty. My father died ages ago.”
hunks.sol: “What are you talking about? Ten million each makes thirty million, not forty. My father died ages ago.”

hunks.baseline: No sooner had Team Leader Choi finished speaking than a blond foreigner came shambling down the hall and dropped heavily into a chair.
hunks.sol: No sooner had Team Leader Choi said it than a blond foreigner came ambling down the hall and dropped into a chair.

hunks.baseline: “Give me food.”
hunks.sol: “Feed me.”

hunks.baseline: Speak of the fucking devil.
Putting everything else aside, the very first thing he said after getting up and seeing our faces made it clear he was a first-rate lout.
hunks.sol: He’d never make a gentleman. The timing of his entrance was one thing; the first words out of his mouth that morning marked him as a first-rate lout.

hunks.baseline: “You gonna get your own damn food, or eat after I smack you?”
hunks.sol: “Are you going to get your own damn food, or get smacked and *then* get your own damn food?”

hunks.baseline: After considering the question carefully, the Skeleton King answered:
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King considered his options carefully.

hunks.baseline: “Good choice. While you’re at it, bring mine, too.”
hunks.sol: “Good choice. Bring mine while you’re at it.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh, and make sure you bring the soup. If you forget, you’ll die.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, and don’t forget the soup. Forget it and you’re dead.”

hunks.baseline: One of the mansion’s greatest advantages was that the artificial intelligence installed in the kitchen was always preparing hot food.
hunks.sol: One of the mansion’s best features was the artificial intelligence in the kitchen, which always had hot food ready.

hunks.baseline: A short while later, the Skeleton King returned with my meal despite grumbling the whole way, and Team Leader Choi stared intently as I devoured the yukgaejang.[^1]
hunks.sol: A little later, the Skeleton King brought me a meal, grumbling all the while. Team Leader Choi watched as I polished off my yukgaejang.[^1]

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, you always eat well.”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, you always have a healthy appetite.”

hunks.baseline: “People aren’t machines. You have to eat to live.”
hunks.sol: “I’m not a machine. I have to eat to live.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It’s been a while. I probably collapsed almost the moment I lay down.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. For the first time in a while. I think I passed out as soon as I lay down.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi nodded as if he had expected that answer.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi nodded as if that explained something.

hunks.baseline: “So that is why you could not answer your phone.”
hunks.sol: “So that is why you did not answer your phone.”

hunks.baseline: “You received calls from several places during the night. Have you still not checked?”
hunks.sol: “Several people called last night. Have you not checked it yet?”

hunks.baseline: Only then did I check my smartphone. It had vibrated so much that I had switched it to silent, but there were now more than a hundred missed calls and messages that had piled up since last night.
hunks.sol: Only then did I take out my smartphone. It had kept vibrating, so I’d set it to silent. Since last night, more than a hundred missed calls and messages had piled up.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell is this?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell?*

hunks.baseline: The names appearing among them were far too familiar and illustrious to dismiss as advertisements or spam.
hunks.sol: The names scattered through the list were too familiar—and too illustrious—to write off as ads or spam.

hunks.baseline: Prince Felix of the United Kingdom, whom I had met during the operation to suppress the Arch-Lich. Faye Chen, an S-rank Hunter.
hunks.sol: Prince Felix of the United Kingdom, whom I’d met during the operation against the Arch-Lich. Faye Chen, an S-rank Hunter.

hunks.baseline: Chuck Hagel of the United States, with whom I had destroyed a terrorist organization only two weeks ago by modern reckoning, and Magic Johnson, a name that had become impossible to leave out.
hunks.sol: Chuck Hagel of the United States, who’d helped me destroy a terrorist organization just two weeks ago in modern-world time. And Magic Johnson, whose name would have been stranger *not* to see.

hunks.baseline: But it did not end there.
hunks.sol: That wasn’t all.

hunks.baseline: President Baek Hanseong was on the list, of course. So were President Doramp Jr. of the United States, whom I had met during my visit to the Pentagon, and Chairman Xiao Yang of China.
hunks.sol: President Baek Hanseong had called, of course. So had President Doramp Jr. of the United States, whom I’d met when I visited the Pentagon, and Chairman Xiao Yang of China.

hunks.baseline: “It was a long night. Longer than I expected.”
Team Leader Choi tilted his coffee cup with a tired expression before continuing.
hunks.sol: “It was a long night,” Team Leader Choi said, raising his coffee cup with a tired look. “Longer than I expected. Though I did hear quite a bit of news.”

hunks.baseline: “Of course, that also allowed me to hear several pieces of news.”
“Yes. Chairman Xiao Yang, in particular, gave me some rather interesting information.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Chairman Xiao Yang, in particular, passed along something interesting.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi tapped the tablet PC in front of him with one long finger. A hologram rose above the screen and projected dozens of images.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi tapped the tablet in front of him with his long fingers. A hologram rose from the screen, projecting dozens of images.

hunks.baseline: When the images finally finished loading, I narrowed my eyes and put down my spoon.
hunks.sol: Once the images had formed, I frowned and put down my spoon.

hunks.baseline: No matter how strong my stomach was or how accustomed I was to gruesome sights, I couldn’t keep eating while looking at something like this.
hunks.sol: I had a strong stomach and was used to gruesome sights, but I couldn’t keep eating while I looked at these.

hunks.baseline: “They were prisoners who were alive and well and incarcerated at Beijing Special Detention Center as recently as last night. And among them are some faces you know, Mr. Jin Taekyung.”
hunks.sol: “As recently as last night, they were alive and being held at Beijing Special Detention Center. You know some of them.”

hunks.baseline: “People I know?”
hunks.sol: “I do?”

hunks.baseline: Instead of answering, Team Leader Choi waved his hand. The dozens of images scattered and vanished, leaving only one behind. That image expanded.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi waved a hand instead of answering. The images scattered and vanished, all but one, which expanded before me.

hunks.baseline: I stared silently at the image.
hunks.sol: I studied it in silence.

hunks.baseline: The face of the middle-aged man lying peacefully, as though he had fallen into a deep sleep, was unmistakably familiar. But the first person to recall his name was not me. It was the Skeleton King.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man lay there peacefully, as though deep in sleep. His face was familiar, but the Skeleton King recalled his name before I did.

hunks.baseline: “That man. His name was, uh…… Wu Shaiming? Something like that. An odd name, in any case.”
hunks.sol: “That human. His name was, ah…… Wu Shaiming? Some peculiar name like that.”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King smiled confidently under the gaze of Team Leader Choi and me.
hunks.sol: He smiled smugly when Team Leader Choi and I looked at him.

hunks.baseline: “Ha-ha. You underestimate the information-gathering abilities of this body. Unlike lazy creatures such as yourselves, I devoted myself to my smartphone even at the expense of my sleeping hours.”
hunks.sol: “Heh. You underestimate my command of information. Unlike you lazy creatures, I have devoted even my sleeping hours to my smartphone.”

hunks.baseline: “You just couldn’t sleep. You’re dead, after all.”
hunks.sol: “You couldn’t sleep. You’re dead.”

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton King grew dejected and began picking at his yukgaejang. Team Leader Choi nodded before speaking.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton King drooped at that and picked at his yukgaejang. Team Leader Choi nodded.

hunks.baseline: “Former Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China and member of the Standing Committee of the Politburo. And……”
hunks.sol: “Former Premier of the State Council of the People’s Republic of China, and a member of the Politburo Standing Committee. And……”

hunks.baseline: I finally remembered everything about Wu Shaiming and cut in.
hunks.sol: It all came back to me.

hunks.baseline: “He was Wu Heixing’s father—the man who joined forces with Lee Jungryong and tried to kill me.”
hunks.sol: “Wu Heixing’s father. His son was the bastard who teamed up with Lee Jungryong to kill me.”

hunks.baseline: “Correct. Wu Shaiming was China’s de facto second-in-command and the leader of the Crown Prince Party, the faction whose head was Chairman Xiao Yang’s greatest political rival.”
hunks.sol: “Correct. Wu Shaiming was effectively China’s second most powerful man, and the leader of the Crown Prince Party—Chairman Xiao Yang’s strongest political rival.”

hunks.baseline: There was no way I wouldn’t know that.
After the operation to suppress the Arch-Lich, Wu Shaiming had raised suspicions about his son’s death, which had led me to learn more about him.
hunks.sol: I knew all that. After the operation against the Arch-Lich, Wu Shaiming had raised questions about his son’s death, and I’d learned plenty about him.

hunks.baseline: One of the main reasons Wu Heixing had been able to cause all kinds of trouble and still escape unscathed was that his father’s family, the Wu clan, was one of China’s most prestigious families.
hunks.sol: One of the main reasons Wu Heixing had been able to cause so much trouble and get away with it was his father’s family. The Wu clan was among China’s most distinguished.

hunks.baseline: But then……
hunks.sol: But……

hunks.baseline: “Didn’t that old man Wu Shaiming get knocked out after all the corruption he’d committed came to light? The last time I saw the news, he was waiting for trial.”
hunks.sol: “Didn’t all that corruption come out and knock Wu Shaiming out of power? Last I heard, he was waiting for trial.”

hunks.baseline: “That is correct. Chairman Xiao Yang did not miss the opportunity, and most of the Crown Prince Party—including Wu Shaiming—was imprisoned.”
hunks.sol: “That is correct. Chairman Xiao Yang seized the opportunity, and most of the Crown Prince Party, including Wu Shaiming, was imprisoned.”

hunks.baseline: “But Wu Shaiming suddenly died?”
hunks.sol: “And now Wu Shaiming is suddenly dead?”

hunks.baseline: “Wu Shaiming was still middle-aged, and he had spent decades drinking potions like water for the sake of his health. His cause of death was sudden cardiac arrest, but there is no way he and some fifty of his relatives could all die the same way at the exact same time.”
hunks.sol: “He was still middle-aged. He had also spent decades drinking potions like water to stay healthy. The recorded cause of death was sudden cardiac arrest. But he and some fifty relatives could not all have died the same way at the same time.”

hunks.baseline: “His relatives? Then the pictures I saw earlier……”
hunks.sol: “Relatives? Then those pictures……”

hunks.baseline: “According to Chairman Xiao Yang’s information, they were all members of the Wu family. There were children among them, too.”
hunks.sol: “According to Chairman Xiao Yang, every one of them belonged to the Wu family. Some were children.”

hunks.baseline: *The annihilation of an entire household.*[^2]
hunks.sol: *The annihilation of a family.*[^2]

hunks.baseline: The words, the sort of phrase one might only hear in Murim, sent a chill down my spine. At the same time, an unbelievable thought flashed through my mind.
hunks.sol: Those words sounded like something out of Murim. A chill ran down my spine, and an almost unbelievable thought struck me.

hunks.baseline: “Team Leader Choi. Could it be that……”
hunks.sol: “Team Leader Choi. You don’t think……”

hunks.baseline: But before I could finish, Team Leader Choi shook his head.
hunks.sol: He shook his head before I could finish.

hunks.baseline: “It was not Chairman Xiao Yang’s doing. If anything, he must have wanted to persuade Wu Shaiming more than anyone.”
hunks.sol: “Chairman Xiao Yang did not do this. If anything, he wanted to win Wu Shaiming over more than anyone.”

hunks.baseline: Persuade him.
hunks.sol: *Win him over.*

hunks.baseline: Wu Shaiming had been Xiao Yang’s most powerful political rival.
Now that he had been rendered incapable of making a comeback, there was no particular reason to kill him—but there was not the slightest reason to keep him alive, either.
hunks.sol: Wu Shaiming had been Xiao Yang’s greatest political rival. Now that he had no hope of a comeback, Xiao Yang had no particular need to kill him. Then again, he had no reason to keep him alive, either.

hunks.baseline: So what exactly had Xiao Yang wanted to gain by persuading him? What had Wu Shaiming possessed?
hunks.sol: So what did he hope to gain by winning him over? What did Wu Shaiming have?

hunks.baseline: The Crown Prince Party’s influence, which had already collapsed? Or the enormous fortune that was practically destined to be seized?
hunks.sol: The Crown Prince Party’s collapsed influence? His vast fortune, which was all but certain to be seized?

hunks.baseline: I silently rolled the word *persuade* around in my mind. Before long, I realized the answer.
hunks.sol: I turned the question over in my mind until the answer came.

hunks.baseline: At the single word that escaped like a groan, the Skeleton King blinked, and Team Leader Choi answered in a low voice.
hunks.sol: The words came out like a groan. The Skeleton King blinked, and Team Leader Choi answered quietly.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Chairman Xiao Yang was trying to win Wu Shaiming over in order to obtain the very Mana Cultivation Method that had turned Wu Heixing into an S-rank Hunter.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Chairman Xiao Yang was trying to obtain the Mana Cultivation Method that made Wu Heixing an S-rank Hunter.”

hunks.baseline: An S-rank Hunter with that level of power would naturally discover a unique training method of his own at some point.
hunks.sol: An S-rank Hunter would generally develop a training method of their own at some point.

hunks.baseline: But Wu Heixing had been different. He had already learned a Mana Cultivation Method passed down through his family, and after his death and Wu Shaiming’s downfall, I had stopped paying much attention to the matter.
hunks.sol: Wu Heixing was different. He had already learned a Mana Cultivation Method passed down through his family. After his death and Wu Shaiming’s downfall, I’d stopped paying much attention to it.

hunks.baseline: *But the fact that Wu Shaiming and all his relatives suddenly died last night means……*
hunks.sol: *But Wu Shaiming and all his relatives died suddenly last night.*

hunks.baseline: I had no interest in what Xiao Yang intended to do with the Mana Cultivation Method.
What mattered was that the annihilation of the Wu family had caused his attempt at persuasion to fail—and who had committed such an atrocity.
hunks.sol: I didn’t care what Xiao Yang planned to do with the method. What mattered was that the destruction of the Wu family had ended his attempt to get it—and who had done that.

hunks.baseline: And I already knew the answer to that question.
hunks.sol: I already knew the answer.

hunks.baseline: “It must have been Odin Guild.”
hunks.sol: “Odin Guild.”

hunks.baseline: A dry voice, unfamiliar even to me, slipped between my lips. Team Leader Choi ran his fingers over his coffee cup, which had gone cold.
hunks.sol: My voice came out dry and unfamiliar. Team Leader Choi touched his coffee cup. The coffee had gone cold.

hunks.baseline: “That is the most likely possibility.”
hunks.sol: “That seems most likely.”

hunks.baseline: “According to Chairman Xiao Yang, Wu Shaiming had been prepared to accept the offer because he had no other choice. If he refused to hand over the Mana Cultivation Method, it would have been perfectly possible for him to receive at least a life sentence, or even the death penalty. But……”
hunks.sol: “According to Chairman Xiao Yang, Wu Shaiming appeared willing to cooperate. He had little choice. If he refused to hand over the Mana Cultivation Method, he faced life imprisonment at the least, and possibly execution. But……”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi suddenly let his words trail off and bit his lip.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi trailed off and bit his lip.

hunks.baseline: “Someone else would not have wanted that.”
hunks.sol: “Someone else did not want him to hand it over.”

hunks.baseline: It felt as though the blood throughout my body had frozen.
hunks.sol: My blood felt cold.

hunks.baseline: *They had made their move.*
Much faster than I had expected, and in a far more brutal way.
hunks.sol: They had made their move. Faster than I’d expected, and with far more cruelty.

hunks.baseline: *But even so, to wipe out an entire household……*
hunks.sol: *An entire family, though……*

hunks.baseline: I stared at the hologram that had yet to disappear. Women, children, and old people. Every one of them had fallen into a deep sleep from which they would never wake.
hunks.sol: I looked at the hologram, still hovering above the table. Women, children, old people. All of them lay in a sleep from which they would never wake.

hunks.baseline: Simply because they had been born into the Wu family.
hunks.sol: Because they had been born into the Wu family.

hunks.baseline: *Were they willing to go this far to prevent the Mana Cultivation Method from leaking, or……*
hunks.sol: *Did they go this far to stop the Mana Cultivation Method from getting out? Or……*

hunks.baseline: *Was this a reply to what happened last night?*
hunks.sol: *Was it an answer to what we did last night?*

hunks.baseline: Several thoughts lingered on the tip of my tongue before scattering. As I silently gazed at the faces of the dead, I suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: The thoughts hovered on the tip of my tongue, then scattered. I stared at the faces of the dead for a while before speaking.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Please, go ahead.”
hunks.sol: “Yes?”

hunks.baseline: “If you have time, would you like to go out for a cup of coffee with me?”
hunks.sol: “If you’ve got time, want to go out for coffee?”

hunks.baseline: “I have no objection. But where are we suddenly going……”
hunks.sol: “I do not mind. But where would we go all of a sudden?”

hunks.baseline: “I wonder. Was it Paris?”
hunks.sol: “Let’s see. Was it Paris?”

hunks.baseline: “What?”
hunks.sol: “Pardon?”

hunks.baseline: As Team Leader Choi looked at me in confusion, I continued calmly.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi looked at me, puzzled. I went on calmly.

hunks.baseline: “Odin Guild. I feel like going to see the boss’s ugly mug.”
hunks.sol: “Odin Guild. I feel like seeing the boss’s face.”

hunks.sol: [^1]: Yukgaejang is a spicy Korean beef soup with vegetables and red pepper seasoning.
